tool.excerpt: In his second start at Aqueduct in September, he was beaten by a neck. At the end of October, trainer Bill Mott sent Sovereignty into stakes company at Churchill Downs in the Grade III Street Sense Stakes over a distance of 1+1⁄16 miles. Leaving the gate a step slow and spotting the field in last place, Sovereignty rallied on the outside through the Churchill stretch and drew away to win by five lengths. === 2025: three-year-old season === Sovereignty was rested until March, when Godolphin and Mott entered him in the three-year-old Kentucky Derby prep races at Gulfstream Park in Florida. His first race of 2025 was the Grade II Fountain of Youth Stakes, in which he again trailed the field before moving up around the turn and down the short stretch of Gulfstream's 1+1⁄16-mile racing configuration, defeating River Thames by a neck. ... Sovereignty (foaled February 22, 2022) is an American retired Thoroughbred racehorse. He won multiple graded stakes races, most notable the 2025 Kentucky Derby, Belmont Stakes, Travers Stakes, and the 2026 Breeders' Cup Classic. Sovereignty became the first horse to win two legs of the American Triple Crown (the Kentucky Derby and the Belmont Stakes) since Justify swept all three Triple Crown races in 2018. == Background == Sovereignty is owned by Godolphin, the thoroughbred stables whose proprietor is Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, the Emir of Dubai.
